title: Item Purge
description: Item Purge automatically removes dropped items after a set time to keep your worlds and servers lag-free. It’s lightweight, configurable, and fully compatible with Configured for easy in-game tweaking.
body:
Features
🔄 Auto-Cleanup: Periodically deletes dropped items to prevent lag buildup.

⚙️ Configurable Interval: Choose how often purges occur (default: every 10 minutes).

✅ Whitelist System: Protect important items (like netherite, stars, or keys) from deletion.

💬 Smart Messaging: Only notifies players when items are actually removed (no chat spam).

🧭 In-Game Configuration: Works with the Configured mod — edit settings directly from the Mods menu.

📜 Admin Commands:

/itempurge now — manually purge items.

/itempurge set <seconds> — change the cleanup interval.

/itempurge whitelist add/remove/list — manage protected items.

Perfect for servers or singleplayer worlds that lag from thousands of dropped items after farms, mob battles, or mining sessions.
Runs quietly in the background, keeping performance high without touching entities or blocks.

MIT — free to modify and include in modpacks with credit.
